copy.title: The Ambani Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Mukesh Ambani’s family: who runs which part of Reliance, the brother who took the other half, the homes, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #029 · The Ambani family · Data as of
copy.h1: India’s richest family sells fuel, phone plans and groceries. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, which part of Reliance each of them runs, which companies you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file. All three children are adults, sit on Reliance’s board and run a piece of the group.
copy.investLede: Reliance Industries and Jio Financial Services trade in Mumbai on the NSE and BSE. Jio Platforms has filed for its own listing.
copy.moneyLede: Most of it is the family’s half of Reliance Industries, held mostly through promoter-group companies. Only Mukesh has a published net worth.
copy.recordLede: What Reliance’s filings, India’s market regulator and property records show. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From a textile company founded in 1966 to the richest family in India.
copy.calcYearsK: Years to earn what Mukesh has
copy.ledgerFoot: A crore is 10 million, so ₹4,000 crore is ₹40 billion. We leave rupee figures in rupees rather than guess an exchange rate. “Our sum” means simple addition of the linked filings or reports.
copy.homesLede: Home is Antilia, a 27-story tower in Mumbai. These are the reported prices of the family’s biggest buys abroad, area level only.

groups: All three are adults on Reliance’s board.

summary.t: Founded Reliance in 1966 as a small textile maker. After he died in 2002, his sons Mukesh and Anil split the empire between them.
Dhirubhai’s widow. She holds 3.14 crore Reliance shares (31.4 million), 0.24% of the company, about twice the stake each member of Mukesh’s household holds directly.
Took half of the family empire when the brothers divided it after their father’s death in 2002.

record.t: In August 2024 India’s market regulator barred him from the securities market for five years and fined him ₹25 crore (₹250 million) in a case over funds diverted from Reliance Home Finance.
In 2019 Mukesh paid a debt Anil’s company owed Ericsson after an Indian court found Anil in contempt over it.

summary.t: Chairs and runs Reliance Industries, which has about $125 billion in revenue from oil refining and petrochemicals, telecom, retail, media and finance. He left Stanford in 1980 to join his father’s company.

owns.t: Chairman. The promoter group he leads owns 50.48% of the company.
Built it inside Reliance; it has more than 500 million subscribers.
Bought the cricket team for $111.9 million in 2008.

record.t: He took no salary from Reliance for the year ended March 31, 2026. Dividends on the promoter group’s shares came to about ₹4,000 crore (₹40 billion).
During the Covid-19 lockdown he raised more than $20 billion by selling about a third of Jio to investors including Facebook and Google.
In 2026 he announced plans to invest $110 billion in AI infrastructure across India over seven years.

facts.t: Reliance’s Jamnagar refinery, which he built, could make 660,000 barrels a day by 2010.
Reliance bought New York’s Mandarin Oriental hotel in 2022 for $98 million.

summary.t: Founder and chair of Reliance Foundation, the group’s charity, and co-owner of the Mumbai Indians. In 2016 she became the first Indian woman elected to the International Olympic Committee.

worth.none: No published estimate of her own.

owns.t: Holds 0.12% directly. Sat on the board from 2014 to 2023 and still attends as a permanent invitee.

facts.t: She opened the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre in Mumbai in March 2023.

summary.t: Isha’s twin. He has chaired Jio Infocomm, Reliance’s telecom company, since June 2022, and joined Reliance’s board in 2023.

owns.t: Board member; holds 0.12%. Paid ₹2.5 crore in commission for the latest year.

summary.t: Akash’s twin. She oversees Reliance’s retail and financial services businesses and joined its board in 2023.

owns.t: Board member; holds 0.12%. Paid ₹2.5 crore in commission for the latest year.

summary.t: The youngest. He heads Reliance’s energy and green energy businesses and is an executive director. He married Radhika Merchant in July 2024.

owns.t: Executive director; holds 0.12%. Paid ₹12.17 crore for the latest year.

companies.name: Reliance Industries
companies.who: Mukesh (chairman) · promoter group 50.48% · all three children on the board
companies.t: Founded by Dhirubhai in 1966. Today it refines oil and runs the Jio phone network and a retail chain, with about $125 billion in revenue.

companies.name: Jio Platforms
companies.who: Akash (chairman of Jio Infocomm) · owned by Reliance
companies.t: Reliance’s telecom and digital arm, with more than 500 million subscribers. It filed to go public in June 2026 and got the regulator’s go-ahead in August; the listing date hadn’t been set as of Oct 1.

companies.name: Reliance Retail
companies.t: The group’s retail arm, which Isha oversees.

companies.name: Jio Financial Services
companies.who: Spun off from Reliance; Isha oversees the group’s financial services
companies.t: Reliance listed its finance arm separately in 2023.

companies.name: Mumbai Indians
companies.t: An Indian Premier League cricket team, bought for $111.9 million in 2008.

extra.t: The family lives in Antilia, a 27-story, 173-meter tower in Mumbai finished in 2010. Reported estimates of its cost run from $1 billion to about $2 billion.
